name: TrueSpend — Invoice Processor (3-Way Match)
description: Polls IMAP for invoices from known suppliers. Claude extracts invoice data from email/PDF. 3-way match: invoice vs PO vs goods receipt. Matched → payment instruction + ERP queue. Mismatch or no PO → one-touch ticket on Operations Board with discrepancy highlighted.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_name: 'invoice_processor', started_at: new Date().toISOString(), status: 'running' }) }}

parameters.name: body
body
parameters.value:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 2048,
  "system": "You are TrueSpend's invoice processing agent. You extract structured data from supplier invoices (email body or PDF attachment text), perform 3-way matching against open purchase orders, and reason on any discrepancies. You are precise about amounts, dates, and references. Always return structured JSON. If the invoice text is base64-encoded PDF content, note that you are reading extracted text.",
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Extract invoice data and perform 3-way match against the open purchase orders below.

INVOICE EMAIL:
From: {{ $node['Extract Email Metadata'].json.from_email }}
Subject: {{ $node['Extract Email Metadata'].json.subject }}
Body: {{ $node['Extract Email Metadata'].json.body_text }}
Attachment text: {{ $node['Extract Email Metadata'].json.attachment_content.substring(0, 3000) }}

SUPPLIER ON RECORD:
{{ JSON.stringify($node['Match Supplier by Email Domain'].json[0]) }}

OPEN PURCHASE ORDERS (eligible for matching):
{{ JSON.stringify($node['Fetch Open POs for Supplier'].json) }}

Match rules:
1. Match by PO number reference in invoice (look in body, subject, attachment)
2. If no PO reference found, match by amount + supplier within ±2% tolerance
3. Amount tolerance: ±2% or ±€50, whichever is larger
4. Delivery must be confirmed (PO status: delivered) for full match

Return JSON exactly:
{
  "invoice_number": string | null,
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" | null,
  "amount": number,
  "vat_amount": number,
  "currency": string,
  "amount_eur": number,
  "vat_rate": number | null,
  "reverse_charge": boolean,
  "matched_po_id": string | null,
  "matched_po_number": string | null,
  "match_result": "matched" | "amount_mismatch" | "no_po" | "no_delivery",
  "match_delta_eur": number,
  "match_confidence": 0.00-1.00,
  "discrepancy_detail": string | null,
  "recommended_action": string,
  "payment_due_days": number
}"
  }]
}

parameters.value1: ={{ ($node['RPC — Confirm 3-Way Match'].json[0] && $node['RPC — Confirm 3-Way Match'].json[0].match_result) || $node['RPC — Confirm 3-Way Match'].json.match_result }}

Payment will be processed within {{ $node['Parse Claude Invoice Extraction'].json.payment_due_days || 30 }} days per contract terms.

TrueSpend Procurement
{{ $env.PROCUREMENT_FROM_EMAIL }}
